name: Indira Quintana (Lala)
bio: Nickname: Lala. Part of Merrick's friend group when JD reconnected in early 2019. By October 2019 she had developed an interest in JD. He didn't reciprocate romantic feelings but was in a depressive state and found her company numbing. Their physical relationship was brief — approximately November and December 2019. JD self-reported to church leadership in January 2020 after Jamie Sinclair's early-morning text. Lala married Aaron Daniels. They have a child. JD and Lala are cordial when their paths cross.
